# Every-Tuesday

> Every-Tuesday is a digital art education platform offering Procreate courses, brush sets, and design resources for creative professionals and beginners.

Every-Tuesday has educated over 250,000 creatives since 2014, specializing in hand lettering, watercolor painting, and digital illustration techniques. The platform combines online courses, curated design resources, and premium digital products to support artists at all skill levels.

## Key Topics

- Procreate
- Hand Lettering
- Digital Art
- Watercolor Florals
- Graphic Design

- Bounce Lettering

## Procreate Courses

- [Beautiful Lettering in Procreate | Every-Tuesday Courses](https://learn.every-tuesday.com/beautiful-lettering): Modern script lettering course in Procreate with brush sets included
- [Messy Watercolors in Procreate | Every-Tuesday Courses](https://learn.every-tuesday.com/messy-watercolors-in-procreate): Digital watercolor painting tutorial with messy aesthetic techniques
- [Gouache Botanicals in Procreate | Every-Tuesday Courses](https://learn.every-tuesday.com/gouache-botanicals-in-procreate): Gouache botanical painting course with 4 painting styles in Procreate
- [Greeting Card Magic in Procreate | Every-Tuesday Courses](https://learn.every-tuesday.com/greeting-card-magic): Greeting card design and pattern combo brush creation in Procreate

## Hand Lettering & Design Courses

- [Bounce Lettering | Every Tuesday](http://courses.every-tuesday.com/p/bounce-lettering): Bounce lettering technique course with practice exercises and cheat sheet
- [Fantastic Flourishes | Every Tuesday](http://courses.every-tuesday.com/p/fantastic-flourishes): Hand lettering flourish techniques and calligraphy design course
- [Watercolor Florals for Graphic Design | Every Tuesday](https://courses.every-tuesday.com/p/watercolor-florals-for-graphic-design): Watercolor florals course for graphic design in Photoshop and Illustrator
